conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Thank you for telling me, Jessica. Because you’re having thoughts of being better off dead, please contact your psychiatrist or IOP team now; if you might act on these thoughts or cannot stay safe, call or text **988** in Canada or call **911**/go to the nearest emergency department.
